Quotes list is paged (KIT 5.1 cursor): getQuotes returns each quote once across pages for every sort; monthly/one-time sums equal the line-item sums on fixtures (integration)

Link to a person: unknown thread links, ambiguous thread keeps one binding and revokes the others, a later inbound message resolves to the linked person, staff are refused, concurrent links resolve to one winner with 'This conversation changed' (throwaway-Postgres tests)

ci green at the exact head; every review comment read; axe + 5 sizes in the browser spec
invariants: Roles filtered at the query/DTO boundary: quotes are OWNER/ADMIN end to end (list and detail); the messages inbox select adds names only, never message content, and staff scoping stays in safeFilters/authorizeThreadInTx
Money is integer cents; quote sums come from EstimateLineItem rows via one groupBy for the page's ids, never per-row queries

Identity linking locks the thread row first (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE), re-checks the actor in the transaction, and never touches consent records; every link/unlink writes its audit event in the same transaction
No live SMS/email/Stripe behavior changes: the inbox is a read + identity-resolution surface; sending paths are untouched
Migrations additive only; this card is expected to need none (bindings and thread columns already exist)

outcome: Quotes and Messages become working tools at their existing URLs: the quotes list stops loading every quote with all its lines and becomes a paged, role-checked KIT 5.1 work queue (status tabs with counts, search by name or quote number, customer/lead filter, four sorts, money sums per quote, and the APPROVED card's primary action 'Make it a rental' anchoring to the existing convert panel); the messages inbox speaks plain words instead of stored codes, shows who each thread is with, and gains the missing 'Link to a person…' flow — a transactional thread-identity domain that links an unknown or ambiguous number to a customer or lead (revoking competing bindings, auditing both ways) so the next inbound message resolves to the right person.
